memory.content: render_invoice must be a pure read-only render: it must never call issue_number() or otherwise touch NEXT_INVOICE. It relies on `invoice.number == 0` being the exact meaning of "unissued draft" (set by Invoice::draft), which is only safe because issue_number() never returns 0 — NEXT_INVOICE starts at 1000 and only increments. If a draft is detected, render the "INVOICE DRAFT" header rather than assigning a number; assigning numbers is solely Invoice::issue's job. Previously the draft branch called issue_number(), so every preview consumed a sequence number and showed a different number each time.

issue_number() must never return 0. Zero is reserved as the "unissued draft" sentinel for Invoice::number (Invoice::draft sets it; render_invoice branches on it to print "INVOICE DRAFT" instead of a number). NEXT_INVOICE starts at 1000 and only increments, which is what guarantees this — do not reset the sequence to 0 or make it wrap, or issued invoices would render as drafts.
